hypotheses.justification: The same proof works after omitting this instance. The definition of sigmaTensor and the lemma sigmaTensor_pow require only [Field K], [Field L], [Algebra K L] and a commutative K-algebra A. For A = Kv, its structures depend on K and v, not on [NumberField L]. Thus the existing rewrites followed by map_mul remain valid for arbitrary field extensions L/K, including infinite ones; i = 0 is simply multiplicativity of the identity.
